$comment: Rule catalog — market. Standard 15, vig removal when relevant. The 'when relevant' is why the reference-present rule accepts a declared absence: not every prediction has a market, and the record must say which case it is rather than leave it to inference.

rules.title: A market reference is given, or its absence is declared
rules.description: The record carries a market-implied probability with its source and as-of instant, or states that no market reference exists and why.
rules.rationale: Where a liquid market exists it is the strongest available reference expectation, and a prediction that ignores it is claiming to know better than the aggregate without saying so. Where none exists, saying so is a one-line answer that stops the omission reading as an oversight.
rules.remediation: Record the market-implied probability and its source, or declare the absence with a reason.

rules.title: The market-implied probability follows from the quoted prices
rules.description: Where raw prices are supplied, the stated implied probability matches what those prices produce under the declared vig-removal method, within the project's tolerance.
rules.rationale: The implied probability is the number the edge is computed against. If it does not follow from the prices, every downstream quantity inherits the discrepancy, and nothing else in the record would reveal it.
rules.remediation: Recompute the implied probability from the quoted prices using the declared method, or correct the prices.
rules.$assuranceNote: Recomputed exactly for the proportional method. For power and shin the evaluator checks only that a method was named and the arithmetic is plausible, because those methods take parameters the record does not carry.

rules.title: The bookmaker margin is removed before the market is treated as a probability
rules.description: Where quoted prices across a market sum to more than one, the record states that the overround was removed and by what method.
rules.rationale: Raw prices are not probabilities: they include the margin that pays the book. Treating them as probabilities overstates every outcome, and an edge measured against them is largely a measurement of the margin — which is how a losing strategy comes to look profitable on paper.
rules.remediation: Remove the overround, record the method used, and state the overround that was removed.
rules.$assuranceNote: The overround is recomputed from the supplied prices, so its presence is established exactly. Whether the removal method suits this market — proportional distributes the margin evenly, which understates favourite-longshot bias — is a modelling judgement this check does not make.
